referenceSource: Official TUM RGB-D: registered optical-Z depth and independent mocap, CC BY4.0 with attribution
visualScope: First/middle/last selected RGB per scene, source-only before study; consistent with official textured planar and zig-zag-panel static controls. Not dense semantic/static-world certification. No sample reselection.
interpretationFloors: Reference validity is independent of LK endpoint/status/photometry; original seed and unknown denominators retained.
Registered depth is warped using own depth/RGB poses; no interpolation or filling.
Depth/mocap is approximate sensor reference, not exact pixel ground truth.
Finite sensitivity terms can overlap and be conservative; compatible fraction is not accuracy certification.
Same-pose projection epipolar self-consistency is by construction, not physical camera validation.
No new road approach FP/FN, metres, phone or realtime acceptance claim; old M3R misses stay unchanged.

actualStudyBudget.geometricAndLkWork: Actual counters and timing required, not zero compute
